caveats: Requires two Channel.notify calls on the same channel to overlap: two checks sharing one channel with concurrent flips, or a test-notification/admin request overlapping sendalerts.
Requires deployment to run concurrent notifiers: sendalerts default threaded mode, multiple sendalerts processes, or web workers alongside sendalerts (deployment model unconfirmed).
Requires a transport to raise permanent TransportError (e.g. Slack 404, Telegram deleted-group) on the losing side.
GIL switch during the window depends on platform behaviour outside the tree: CPython releasing the GIL in blocking pycurl/socket I/O.
DB interleaving assumes read-committed isolation with no added locking (no select_for_update, no transaction around notify).
subclaims.reason: Channel.notify snapshots disabled into a local (hc/api/models.py:815), then blocks in transport.notify (hc/api/models.py:817, for example pycurl perform in hc/lib/curl.py:160 with 10s timeout and retries in hc/api/transports.py:237,247-261) before unconditionally writing the snapshot back (hc/api/models.py:823-825), setting True only on permanent TransportError (hc/api/transports.py:80-83, hc/api/models.py:819). Each sendalerts flip runs on its own thread (hc/api/management/commands/sendalerts.py:53-55,94-95) via Flip.send_alerts (hc/api/management/commands/sendalerts.py:36, hc/api/models.py:1128,1130), so two flips sharing one channel load it (SELECT at hc/api/models.py:1128) and overlap in the network call. If thread B finishes first with a permanent failure (for example Slack 404 in hc/api/transports.py:349-356, Telegram deleted-group in hc/api/transports.py:630-637) its UPDATE writes disabled=True, then thread A finishing with success or transient failure overwrites it with its stale False/None snapshot. Under read-committed the SELECT snapshot and the later UPDATE are separate unlocked statements with no re-read or transaction around notify, so the lost update is allowed. The GIL does not rule it out because the window holds blocking network/socket I/O that releases the GIL; the same overlap is reachable from a test-notification request (hc/front/views.py:1171) or admin send (hc/api/admin.py:76) concurrent with sendalerts, or two sendalerts processes.
